facts.material: blend of saturated (carboxyl-functional) polyester resin and epoxide resin, with pigments and additives (assumed polyester predominates by weight)
facts.function: thermosetting coating applied electrostatically and cured by heat

gri_path: GRI 1: powder coatings are not paints or varnishes of 3208-3210 (not dispersed or dissolved in a medium); as polymer powders they are primary forms of chapter 39 (note 6(b))
Chapter 39 note 4 / subheading note: a blend of polymers is classified according to the polymer predominating by weight; polyester is assumed to predominate
GRI 6: 3907.9 other polyesters > 3907.99 other (saturated) > 3907.99.50 other > 3907.99.50.50 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: epoxide resins; correct only if the epoxy portion predominates by weight
paints of heading 3208 must be dispersed or dissolved in a non-aqueous medium; powder coatings are not
unsaturated polyesters; hybrid powder polyester is saturated

missing_facts: What is the weight ratio of polyester resin to epoxy resin in the powder (which polymer predominates)?
Is the polyester saturated or unsaturated?
classification.rationale: Powder coatings are polymer powders in primary form rather than paints dispersed in a medium, so they fall in chapter 39. Under chapter 39 note 4 a polymer blend goes to the heading of the polymer predominating by weight; hybrid powders are usually polyester-rich, giving other saturated polyesters, 3907.99.50.50 (H88731 placed a saturated polyester resin for powder coatings in 3907.99; the code it cites, 3907.99.0050, is now line 3907.99.50.50). If epoxy predominates, N239953 supports 3907.30.00.00, so the answer abstains on the resin ratio.
